primary_comparison: Matched corrected seed 40 cases with the same archived C-H procedure using original regional constraints. Flat 31-H and 29-H are separate reference and sensitivity maps.

topological.axial: saved certified intervals; any exact nonempty intersection (including endpoint and overlap) gives one undirected edge
topological.segment: split selected intervals at exact contacts, merge coincident atoms retaining owners, and connect atoms with an exact shared endpoint
topological.convex: certified globally maximal polygon IDs; positive exact rational interior intersection area gives one edge

traversal.states: two directed traversals per positive-length atom, representing arrival at its far endpoint
traversal.transitions: outgoing traversal must depart at the incoming state endpoint; all outgoing directions admissible
traversal.turn_cost: unsigned heading deflection in degrees, nearest integer microdegree (half to even)
traversal.reversal: 180 degrees at the physical endpoint, then traverse the same atom in reverse
traversal.start_and_end: physical segment midpoints with free endpoint orientation; seed each start orientation once, and accept every target orientation tied at the minimum
traversal.angular: lexicographic sum of quantised turns then count of transitions
traversal.metric: lexicographic midpoint-to-midpoint geometric travel length then transition count; each edge adds half the two incident segment lengths quantised separately to microunits, minimum one unit per segment
traversal.angular_metric: fixture-only alternative: angular cost, then metric travel length, then transitions
traversal.zero_cost: straight transitions add no angular cost and one hop; every lexicographic step is strictly positive
traversal.path_choice: sum of fractions of equally optimal directed paths through each physical segment, counted once per path, through neither endpoint. Divide unordered-pair contributions by (n-1)(n-2)/2; zero when n < 3

common_measures.degree: number of distinct neighbours in the physical adjacency graph
common_measures.depth: average shortest distance to reachable nonself elements; null for isolates
common_measures.integration: (reachable/(n-1))/(1+mean depth); zero for isolates; inverse depth rather than RA/RRA
common_measures.topological_choice: unweighted, undirected betweenness, excluding endpoints and sharing all equal-optimal paths
common_measures.disconnection: retains all elements, no credit from unreachable pairs, depth on reachable nodes only; diameter null
common_measures.intelligibility: Pearson r of degree and integration, undefined for a constant array or fewer than two observations
common_measures.clustering: mean local unweighted physical clustering coefficient
common_measures.summaries: unweighted node observations, population standard deviation and population standardised third moment
common_measures.top_choice_share: fractional boundary rank at 5% and 10%; equal values have equal contribution; shares undefined when total choice is zero
common_measures.spatial_high_choice: all positive-choice elements at or above the observed 90th-percentile rank cutoff, including ties; vertex-mean centres, unweighted centroid and RMS radius

spatial.display: fixed 100 x 100 canvas, shared colour limits per measure and representation in terrain comparisons
spatial.flat40_overlay: 4-unit integer lattice offset by one unit from lower bounds, strict accessible-space inclusion; exact rational closed convex coverage and exact squared Euclidean nearest axial/segment elements within 3 units, retaining all nearest ties
spatial.field: arithmetic mean over contributing element scores. Pair correlations use the same locations with all three representations; no array-index matching. Convex multiplicity areas use archived exact arrangement, while local score maps are point samples.
